summary: Request: Audit logs proving guardrails eval checks ran (and passed) before Optimize config changes were applied
description:
Customer request (Compliance / Evidence):
Northbridge Support is preparing an internal audit review and needs verifiable audit logs demonstrating that quality guardrails evaluation checks were executed BEFORE any Optimize-driven cost configuration change was applied.

They specifically asked for:
1) An auditable event trail showing: who initiated the Optimize apply, what changed, what eval suite/prompt-set revision ran, gating decision (pass/fail), and timestamps.
2) Evidence that an "apply" was blocked if gating failed (or that an override was explicitly used).
3) Guidance on how to export these events to their SIEM (or download from Console).

Context:
- Customer previously escalated a quality regression after a quantization change (see SUP-18422).
- They are now requiring auditability as a condition for enabling more aggressive Optimize recommendations.

Customer-provided details:
- Tenant: northbridge-prod
- Change window: 2025-01-20 18:00–20:00 UTC
- Route: /v1/chat/completions (primary prod route)
- Model pinned: llama-3.1-70b-instruct

Requested artifacts:
- Export of relevant audit events for the above window.
- Documentation link describing the event schema (they referenced our internal spec name: "OptimizeConfigChange" and gating fields).
comments:
2025-01-21 09:18 (Owen Phillips, Support) — Intake
Customer asks for audit logs proving eval checks ran before Optimize applied cost changes. They referenced our audit-event spec (OptimizeConfigChange) and want an export for 2025-01-20 18:00–20:00 UTC (tenant northbridge-prod). Looping in Platform/Audit.

Questions for Eng:
- Are OptimizeConfigChange events already emitted for this tenant in prod?
- Do we also emit a separate GuardrailsGatingRun event, or only embed gating summary in OptimizeConfigChange?
- Best customer-facing method for export (Console vs API)?

2025-01-21 10:02 (Felix Schneider, Console/Audit UI backend) — Assigned / initial triage
We do emit OptimizeConfigChange audit events in prod for enterprise tenants; gating summary is included when guardrails enforcement is enabled.

For export:
- Console: Admin → Audit Logs (if their role has AuditLogViewer)
- API: /v1/audit/events?tenant_id=...&start=...&end=...

I’ll pull the exact events for their window and confirm required fields are present per spec. If any fields are missing, we may need to backfill or provide the gating_run_id references.

2025-01-21 11:40 (Felix Schneider) — Findings (internal)
Queried audit-events store for tenant=northbridge-prod, window 2025-01-20 18:00–20:00 UTC.
Observed:
- 3 OptimizeConfigChange events
- 2 were "applied" and include gating_decision=PASS
- 1 was "blocked" and includes gating_decision=FAIL
No overrides observed in this window.

Each event includes:
- actor (user_id + email)
- config_delta summary
- gating_run_id
- eval_suite_id + eval_suite_version
- prompt_set_id + prompt_set_revision
- decision timestamps (eval_started_at, eval_completed_at, decision_recorded_at)

Next: provide customer an export + a short explanation mapping fields to their requirement "eval ran before apply" (eval_completed_at precedes applied_at).

2025-01-21 12:05 (Owen Phillips, Support) — Reply drafted to customer (pending Eng confirmation)
We can provide an audit export showing:
- The evaluation run ID and timestamps
- The gating pass/fail decision
- The Optimize config change status (applied vs blocked)
- The model version and prompt-set revision used

Confirming with Eng: exact field names + whether you can self-serve export via Console/API, or if you prefer we deliver a CSV/JSON bundle for the requested time window.

2025-01-22 08:33 (Felix Schneider) — Customer-facing guidance + sample
Confirmed field names match the Confluence spec (OptimizeConfigChange).

Sample (redacted) excerpt we can share (as JSON lines) demonstrating ordering:
- eval_completed_at: 2025-01-20T18:41:12Z
- decision: PASS
- applied_at: 2025-01-20T18:41:21Z

For the blocked attempt:
- decision: FAIL
- applied_at is absent; status=BLOCKED

Also: audit events include gating_failure_reasons[] (high-level strings) but do NOT include raw prompt text or model outputs (PII-safe). That’s usually acceptable for compliance teams; if they require artifacts, we can provide separate eval artifact retention policy details (summaries retained longer than raw outputs).

2025-01-22 09:10 (Owen Phillips, Support) — Sent to customer
Provided:
1) Exported OptimizeConfigChange audit events for 2025-01-20 18:00–20:00 UTC (tenant northbridge-prod), including gating fields.
2) Explanation: for applied changes, eval_completed_at precedes applied_at; for failures, status=BLOCKED and no apply timestamp is recorded.
3) How to self-serve going forward:
   - Console → Admin → Audit Logs → filter by event type "OptimizeConfigChange" and time range
   - Audit Log API endpoint (if enabled for your tenant) to pull into SIEM
4) Documentation reference: internal spec we follow for the event payload (Optimize config change audit events).

Asked customer to confirm whether they need a formal letter of attestation vs raw event export.

2025-01-23 14:22 (Customer, Northbridge Support) — Follow-up
Thanks—this is what we needed. Two follow-ups:
1) Can you confirm retention period for these audit events?
2) Do overrides show up explicitly (who approved / justification)?

2025-01-24 09:05 (Felix Schneider) — Retention/override details (for Support)
Retention:
- Audit events: 1 year for enterprise tenants (minimum), searchable in Console for default 90 days; older windows available via export request or API depending on tenant settings.
- Eval artifacts: summaries retained; raw outputs may be shorter retention and are configuration-dependent.

Overrides:
- If an override is used, OptimizeConfigChange includes override_used=true plus fields for justification and approver identity (subject to RBAC).

2025-01-24 09:30 (Owen Phillips, Support) — Sent to customer + resolution
Confirmed retention policy for audit events and clarified the Console search window vs longer-term export availability.
Confirmed override auditing: override_used flag + justification + approver identity captured when override pathway is used (and RBAC restricted).

Customer acknowledged and closed request.

2025-01-24 09:32 (Owen Phillips) — Resolution
Resolved by providing audit log export for requested window and documenting self-serve access + retention/override semantics.

Internal follow-ups:
- None required for this ticket. If customer requests SIEM streaming/webhook, route to Security/Compliance + Platform (Kevin Osei / Naomi Feldman).
resolution: Provided exported OptimizeConfigChange audit events demonstrating guardrails eval checks ran and passed prior to apply; included one blocked attempt with gating failure. Shared guidance on Console/API export, retention, and override audit fields. Customer confirmed requirements met.
